children: The company's consolidated revenue rose 14.74 per cent to Rs 4,396.48 crore, while its workforce crossed 5 lakh, driven by strong hiring in the General Staffing business

Quess Corp on Friday posted a 44.21 per cent year-on-year increase in consolidated net profit to Rs 74.66 crore for the September quarter of FY27, supported by growth in revenue across its business segments.
The company had posted a consolidated net profit of Rs 51.77 crore in the corresponding quarter of the previous financial year, according to a regulatory filing.
Revenue from operations rose 14.74 per cent to Rs 4,396.48 crore during the quarter, compared with Rs 3,831.60 crore a year earlier.
The company's board of directors also approved an interim dividend of Rs 5 per share.

Quess Corp's workforce crossed the 5 lakh mark during the quarter, with its General Staffing business accounting for more than 20,000 additional employees, Executive Director and Group CEO Lohit Bhatia said.

The General Staffing segment added 116 new clients and recorded 15 per cent year-on-year revenue growth and 23 per cent growth in earnings before interest, tax, depreciation and amortisation (EBITDA), he said.
The Professional Staffing business reported 13 per cent revenue growth, supported by continued hiring demand from global capability centres (GCCs), Bhatia added.

Quess Corp's overseas business also maintained its growth momentum despite geopolitical challenges in the Middle East, reporting a 10 per cent increase in revenue and 23 per cent growth in EBITDA during the quarter.
Higher margins in the Middle East supported the segment's performance, while Malaysia, Singapore and the Philippines contributed to revenue expansion, Bhatia said.
